statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient is diagnosed with codes R55 and G45.9
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
